title: Declared source ownership
responsibility: Builds a lookup from exact file and directory declarations to their owning unit ids.

inputs.name: unitOwners.units
inputs.description: Units with ids and source entries; a trailing slash means every path under that directory.

outputs.name: unitOwners
outputs.description: Lookup function returning sorted unique owner ids for a path, from exact file matches and directory prefixes. No owner is inferred from naming.
